atoms.text: The third main group of organisms is microorganisms. Microorganisms are tiny living things that can only be seen with a microscope.

instruction.text: Select the image of a microorganism.
Read the sentences and fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Microorganisms are classified into ((++two ten)) main groups: bacteria and fungi.
Bacteria are ((++unicellular multicellular)), which means they are made up of only one cell. Fungi are ((unicellular ++multicellular)), so they are made up of many cells.
Some microorganisms can be ((big ++harmful)) and can cause diseases. These microorganisms are also known as germs.
Other microorganisms can be ((++helpful happy)). For example, some microorganisms live inside humans and help us to digest our food.
Another helpful microorganism is yeast. Yeast is a type of ((++fungi bacteria)) that is used to bake things like bread.

instruction.text: Select the things that all living things can do.

hint.text: More than one answer can be correct.

feedback.end: Viruses are sometimes also considered to be microorganisms, but this definition can get a bit tricky! They don’t need to feed or get rid of waste, and they make copies of themselves instead of reproducing. This means that viruses are not living things, so they are often classified as their own group!
